title: JailbreakSkill: Scaling Automated Red-Teaming with Reusable and Ever-Evolving Skills
abstract: arXiv:2608.16465v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated red-teaming has produced a growing collection of attack strategies, yet they typically remain scattered across prompts and workflows, making them difficult to systematically integrate, reuse, and improve at scale. We introduce \textsc{JailbreakSkill}, a skill-centric framework for scaling automated red-teaming through reusable and continuously evolving attack capabilities. \textsc{JailbreakSkill} packages existing attack strategies into modular, agent-ready skills that can be directly reused and adaptively selected across tasks and target models. Beyond reuse, it closes the loop between attacking and learning: attack experience is used to diagnose, refine, combine, and discover new skills, which are added back to an ever-growing skill library. translated_title: 越狱技能：通过可重用且不断演进的技能扩展自动化红队测试
translated_abstract: 自动化红队测试已产生越来越多的攻击策略，但这些策略通常分散在各种提示词和工作流程中，难以系统性地整合、复用和大规模改进。我们引入了JailbreakSkill，一个以技能为中心的框架，通过可重用且持续演进的攻击能力来扩展自动化红队测试。JailbreakSkill将现有攻击策略封装为模块化、智能体可用的技能，这些技能可以在不同任务和目标模型之间直接复用并自适应选择。除了复用之外，它还闭环了攻击与学习的过程：攻击经验被用于诊断、改进、组合和发现新技能，并将这些新技能添加到不断增长的技术库中。这种演进在AdvBench上将宏平均攻击成功率（ASR）提升了17.5个百分点，在HarmBench上提升了13.4个百分点，其中包括在AdvBench上针对GPT-5.4取得了48.6个百分点的提升，同时产生了新颖的越狱技能。
tldr: 本文提出JailbreakSkill框架，将攻击策略封装为可复用且持续演进的技能库，通过攻击与学习的闭环显著提升自动化红队测试的攻击成功率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces JailbreakSkill, a skill-centric framework that packages attack strategies into reusable and ever-evolving skills, closing the loop between attacking and learning to significantly boost automated red-teaming performance.
